title: On hypercyclic and (common) upper frequently hypercyclic subspaces
summary: Let $B$ be a unilateral weighted backward shift on $\ell_p$, $1 \leq p < \infty$, that admits a $\mathscr{U}$-frequently hypercyclic subspace. We prove that $B$ admits such a subspace free of frequently hypercyclic vectors. The proof technique we develop also allows us to prove that $B$ admits a hypercyclic subspace free of $\mathscr{U}$-frequently hypercyclic vectors, and to solve a question posed by Bès and Menet in 2015 on the existence of common $\mathscr{U}$-frequently hypercyclic subspaces.
